record_type_quote: We replicated and extended Hanley et al. (2014) and Santiago et al. (2016). We demonstrated the positive effects of stregthening FCRs, tolerance responses, and engagement with reinforcers identiﬁed via interview and analysis on problem behaviors with two young children diagnosed with ASD.
